scope: Research-only photograph comparison board for the 22 Phase41 P1 handpicked selections; no gallery replacement or photo permission inference

evidence.score_summary: Phase28 SIFT/homography best candidate for each selected owner image (per-painting not per-candidate image test).
evidence.object_image_scope: The actual archived photo bytes are displayed side by side; no subjective colour/crop/fidelity approval issued.

editorial_next_actions: Inspect per-pair framing, crop, panel scope, details vs full painting and colour/exposure against handpicked reference.
For institutional candidates with manifest RIGHTS_UNDETERMINED, do not infer reuse rights from the canvas or from Commons Public Domain label.
For PDM/CC0 declarations, confirm the declaration applies to the exact photographic bytes supplied, not merely the historical painting object.
Mark a replacement eligible only after legal/photographic/editorial approval, not automatically from dimensions or homography.
Preserve original selected image bytes, aliases, explicit rejects and placement restrictions.
After approved individual photographs, update curated image bank and test app, Prayer/Calendar placement only when authorized.

visual_screening.reviewer: assistant visual inspection of four Phase42 contact-sheet image groups
visual_screening.limitations: Contact-sheet/thumbnail inspection. Full-resolution image/color-managed QA and legal/licence checks are required before approval.
